metric_hodge_definition.input_contract: G is an oriented positive covariant metric, H=G^-1, and v>0 satisfies v^2=det(G)
metric_hodge_definition.coefficient_formula: coefficient of e_(I^c) in star_G(e_J) is sgn(I,I^c)*v*det(H[I,J])
metric_hodge_definition.exact_backend: rational or exact-algebraic inputs with supplied exact volume root; interval inputs use the same finite minor formula
metric_hodge_definition.T51_specialization: G=I and v=1 gives the CBF.T51 signed-permutation table

eight_shape_first_variation.interpretation: all eight Hermitian shape fields are visible to the full Hodge operator; none may be dropped before source selection
